statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis is documented under codes I48.0 and I48.91
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated
The procedure is needed to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
The procedure is needed to optimize rate control and assess for further arrhythmic burden
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
